verdict.summary: The streaming recovery implementation preserves the existing framing, torn-tail, checksum, record-order, duplicate-detection, and truncation behavior while replacing the whole-log allocation with one reused payload buffer. The differential tests compare the streaming and buffered scanners across intact and structurally torn inputs, verify fail-closed checksum handling and error offsets for both interior and final-record corruption, and exercise the claimed memory-bound property. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test issue is apparent in the supplied diff.
